conditions.catalyst: CuO-coated Cu foam on PTFE/PP membrane (electrified membrane cathode, 4 cm2)
conditions.cell: flow_cell (trap | cathode membrane | cathode chamber | Nafion 117 | anode chamber), recirculated at 50 mL/min
conditions.electrolyte: feed: 25 mM NO3-, 10 mM Cl-, pH ~7, 5 h per cycle; the same trap solution reused for three feed batches

checks: Per-cycle increments 20.5, 19.6-19.8, 21.2 mM, consistent with ~83 % of 25 mM per batch (Fig. 2e: 20.9 mM in the trap at 300 min). Implies the trap concentration axis is on the same per-volume basis as the feed.
